summary: Solid test suite covering all major requirements (version parsing, commit analysis, bumping logic, changelog generation, workflow validation). Well-structured with three layers: unit tests (VersionBumper.Tests.ps1), integration tests via act (Run-ActTests.ps1), and workflow structure tests (Workflow.Tests.ps1). Main gaps: limited edge case coverage (pre-release versions, unicode in commits, very large version numbers, concurrent updates), fixture file contents not shown so can't verify test scenario differentiation, act test runner hardcodes cases rather than parameterizing, and no error handling tests for malformed package.json in Update-VersionFile. Would catch most regressions but has room for improvement in robustness and maintainability.
